purpose: Route paid IP12 OpenAI analysis through managed egress without ambiguous resubmission.

source.deployment_ref_requirement: exact merged main commit containing code_source_commit and both locked postimage blobs

pre_write_checks: persistent repository is clean and on the exact merged main commit selected for deployment
selected merged main commit contains code_source_commit and both locked postimage blobs
both runtime files match their locked preimage SHA-256 values before any write
both candidate files match their locked postimage Git blob and SHA-256 values
python -m py_compile succeeds for both staged candidate files
isolated import of content_domains.egress and content_domains.digital_ip succeeds against disposable state
deployment_steps: record service PID, start time and active state
create one timestamped backup directory and copy both verified preimages into it
stage both verified postimages on the same filesystem as their runtime targets
atomically replace both runtime files only after every pre-write check passes
verify both runtime postimage SHA-256 values and repeat syntax/import validation
require service active state and GET /api/gen/health HTTP 200
post_deploy_checks: both runtime files match their locked postimage SHA-256 values
huangque-content.service is active after one restart
the unauthenticated probe creates no job, point transaction or outbound model request
no paid model request is issued during deployment verification

rollback.trigger: any replace, syntax, import, restart, service-state, hash or health check failure
rollback.method: stop forward deployment, atomically restore both timestamped preimages as one unit, verify both preimage hashes, then restart huangque-content.service once
verify: both runtime files match their locked preimage SHA-256 values
huangque-content.service returns to the recorded active state
the rollback probe creates no job, point transaction or outbound model request
